class TokenBucket:
    def admit_request(self, now):
        self.credits = min(self.capacity, self.credits + self.refill_rate * elapsed)
        if self.credits < 1: return False
        self.credits -= 1
        return True

def read_if_fresh(self, key, clock):
    item = self.entries.get(key)
    if item is None or clock.now() >= item.expires_at:
        self.entries.pop(key, None)
        return None
    return item.value

async def commit_if_current(self, lease, result):
    current = await self.store.read_generation(lease.job_id)
    if current != lease.generation:
        raise StaleLease(lease.job_id)
    await self.store.commit_result(lease.job_id, result, generation=current)
